title: Taking advantage of people with ADHD
body:
They claim to help ADHD, but no one with ADHD is safe to use this app without feeling like they were pulled a fast one.
I downloaded and PAID in several steps while using Fabulous, included when they sent me to Clarify after I’ve already started a free trial on Fabulous. I did it because I was desperate for an efficient solution for my ADHD. One week after using both apps I realized they weren’t helping me at all and tried to cancel my free trial subscription where ALL subscriptions are canceled - the IPhone Settings. Fabulous and Clarify don’t show up there at all. 2 weeks go by and I was charged almost 96€ from this app. Fortunately they processed my refund very quickly when I asked for one. But still I had a terrible experience with the app and truly believe Fabulous is taking advantage of people with ADHD.
author: matilda mingates
